title: Conformance baseline acceptance v2 — 2026-11-23 (head d7e2e4fb)
body:
# Conformance baseline acceptance v2 — 2026-11-23 (head d7e2e4fb)

## Context

The baseline was first re-accepted at snapshot `a2c48db0`. The seed was then regenerated from its
own sources (the slice plans, the issue registry and the measured coverage), as the repository's
seed builder requires. The regeneration shows that S21's plan status is `active`, matching its live
record; the earlier `closed` seed status was stale seed data, not an under-delivery. T0 and T4
remain plan-closed and live-active, and are real rework.

## Decision

The programme's conformance baseline is re-accepted from the head snapshot at `d7e2e4fb`:

- `seed_live_drift S21` is **deleted** from the baseline: the regenerated seed and the live record
  agree, so there is no live gap. This is a deletion, not a re-dating.
- `seed_live_drift T0` remains owned under the programme owner with the 2027-02-18 reassessment
  date. T0 is in tranche 0, which is closed, so it may close through its own chain.
- `seed_live_drift T4` remains owned under the programme owner with the 2027-02-18 reassessment
  date. T4 is in tranche 4, which is authorised, so it may close through its own chain.
- Every other entry is derived from the live gaps in this snapshot; an entry whose gap is gone is
  deleted, never re-dated, and no disposition is changed to hide a gap.

## Consequences

The strict gate passes with zero unbaselined P0/P1 and no expired entry. The seed is never
hand-edited to hide a gap; it is regenerated from its sources and this record names the difference.
T0 and T4 close through their own tranche chains. S21 stays active until its tranche is authorised.

## Evidence

- Head snapshot: `d7e2e4fb`; 295 snapshot files; the manifest sha256 is recorded in the baseline
  header.
- Strict audit: `audit-programme-conformance.py --strict --fail-on P0,P1 --baseline
  docs/evidence/conformance-baseline.json`.
- Journal: the acceptance is replayed through `documents.compose` and read back by id.
